Which POS systems does Maple work with?

Maple takes phone orders into Chowbus, Clover, Genius, Lightspeed, Linga, NCR Aloha, NCR Voyix, Oracle Simphony, OrderCounter, Quantic, Shift4 Dine, Smile, SpotOn, Square, Toast and Tray. Each system has its own page with the details of how orders reach it.
Which Maple plan includes POS integrations?

Maple Pro costs $350/month with monthly billing or $220/month with annual billing. It adds phone ordering, supported POS integrations, and reservations. Maple Voice costs $150/month with monthly billing or $85/month with annual billing. It covers phone answering, hours and FAQs, and automated call transfer.

Yes. Maple Pro includes OpenTable reservations. Maple checks availability and makes bookings over the phone, and handles changes and cancellations when it can find the booking, within your cancellation rules.
What if my POS is not listed?

Maple Voice answers every call, covers hours and FAQs, and transfers callers to your staff without any POS connection. For a system we do not support yet, talk to our team: Maple builds custom integrations on Enterprise plans.
